pix/host/workflow/launch._launch_ux_note: Launch UX wave: SessionDeps.SpawnCreate, the dedicated create-child seam (and spawnCreate's fallback to Spawn). The create is the ONE non-interactive child of a launch and needs the opposite stdio from a session; telling the two apart by seam rather than by sniffing argv is what keeps a future create-argv change from silently re-routing the user's terminal. PIX_HOME cleanup reads the memory port from .state through pixhome instead of config.toml (+1 edge). sbx 0.41 follow-up: EnvCreateArgs now carries --auto-approve because captured stdin is non-TTY and sbx refuses the already trust-gated plan without the explicit flag. Recreate-output follow-up: a failed sbx removal's first output line passes through sys.TerminalSafe before it reaches the user's terminal. Rebaselined ONCE to the EXACT current value, no slack.

pix/host/stack._prod_loc_note: Coexistence review fix (LOW): CanonicalPath no longer swallows an EvalSymlinks failure. A path that exists but cannot be resolved is an error; a path that does not exist yet resolves its deepest EXISTING ancestor and re-appends the missing components, so a PIX_HOME under a symlinked parent keeps ONE stack id across its own creation. The growth is that walk plus the reasoning for the two distinct failure modes.
